name: Milalai
title: Levitical musician at the wall in Jerusalem
summary: Milalai was one of the Levitical musicians who took part in the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt wall under Nehemiah's leadership. He played musical instruments and joined one of the two large thanksgiving processions that marched on the wall. He is mentioned only once in the Bible, in Nehemiah 12.

keyEvents.title: Dedication of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Milalai took part in the great dedication celebration of Jerusalem's rebuilt wall, where two large thanksgiving processions marched.

keyEvents.title: Procession with Musical Instruments
keyEvents.description: Milalai was among the Levitical musicians who carried David's musical instruments in the procession along the wall, under the leadership of Ezra the scribe.

keyEvents.title: Praise and Thanksgiving on the Wall
keyEvents.description: Milalai and the other musicians contributed to the great thanksgiving celebration with singing and music when the two processions met at God's house.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's Organization of the Celebration
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah organized the dedication of the wall and appointed Levites and musicians, including Milalai, to take part in the procession.
